content:
Maria Hernandez: quick heads-up — console shows negative per-call cost for a tenant during model warmup after prefetch. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/warmup-nag.png
Dave Kim: oof. negative cost is scary. do you have a specific example / timeframe?
Maria Hernandez: saw it on tenant `acme-inc` in the last hour. the per-call tile showed -$0.003 for the first ~12 calls, then normalizes. looks like cache crediting is over-apportionating during the amortization window.
Joanne Patel: can you paste a sample telemetry row? curious how our credits are emitted to the econ pipeline.
Maria Hernandez: grabbing one now, from ingestion: ```{
  "invocation_id": "inv-2026-03-23-001",
  "tenant_id": "acme-inc",
  "model_sku": "rw-3b-quant",
  "tokens_total": 482,
  "tokens_cached": 420,
  "cache_credits_assigned": 15,
  "prefetch_amort_window": 1000,
  "timestamp": 1784512300
}```
Dave Kim: thanks. I think the problem is our UI amortization math — we divide prefetch_cost by amort_window but then subtract cache_credits_assigned per-invocation twice when tokens_cached > tokens_total * threshold.
Joanne Patel: yep that double-subtract would flip the slice negative if the amort window is small and sampling weight is >1. our ingestion adds `cache_credits_assigned` and we also apply a sampled_prefetch_credit in the console layer.
Dave Kim: proposed fix: stop applying sampled_prefetch_credit at UI-layer when `cache_credits_assigned` present OR change telemetry to emit a boolean `prefetch_credit_emitted` so UI can be authoritative.
Maria Hernandez: preference for telemetry change — UI decisions based on raw signal is brittle. if ingestion can emit a single canonical field we won't have to maintain the same logic in two places.
Joanne Patel: agree. minimal telemetry change: add `prefetch_credit_bucket` and `prefetch_credit_origin` (values: "ingest", "ui", "router"). example: "prefetch_credit_origin":"ingest". keeps backward compat.
Dave Kim: implementation notes: backend ingest pipeline currently writes econ rows to `econ.v1_invocations`. we'll add two string fields. migration: default null for older rows. UI: if `prefetch_credit_origin` == "ingest" then skip UI sampling adjust.
Maria Hernandez: UX ask — can we also expose a small "amortization preview" in the hovercard that shows how the first N calls get credits applied (not just the final unit cost)? product wants to avoid folks seeing 'mystery negative cost' screenshots in support.
Joanne Patel: doable. UI will compute a notched view: bands showing amortized credit allocation per-call up to window. need API: `/econ/preview?tenant=acme&invocation=inv-...` returning the first 50 steps. we'll return the proto in-line or the precomputed vector.
Dave Kim: caution: returning the full vector for every hover could be heavy. prefer server-side sampling + TTL cache keyed by (tenant, prefetch_id). fallback: precompute only when a canary or when support clicks "show amortization".
Maria Hernandez: fine with an on-demand preview that hits a new readonly endpoint. make default hovercard summary still concise.
ops-bot: deploy queued: econometrics-ingest v3.4 -> staging at 1784512600 by @joanne. :rocket:
Joanne Patel: I'll implement telemetry fields and add a feature flag `econ_client_side_sampling_v2=false` so we can flip the UI behavior once ingest is live.
Dave Kim: I'll add a lightweight server-side preview endpoint that computes the first 50 amortized steps from the stored prefetch metadata. returns compressed list.
Maria Hernandez: action items: 1) Joanne add fields + feature flag, 2) Dave add preview endpoint + docs, 3) Maria prepare a short support note and a console hovercard mock. target: patch to staging in next 48h. anyone object?
Dave Kim: nope, 👍
Joanne Patel: good plan. I'll post PR link when ready.
Maria Hernandez: thanks all — helps reduce support noise. cc @product for visibility. :thumbsup:
